answer: Admission auction keeps the ocean honest. Each epoch only 50 slots are auctioned: a newcomer bids with a quill credential plus a deposit twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. A sybil operator wanting 1,000 fake identities must win 1,000 auctions, paying 60,000 POA for a 3,000 POA pool, twenty times the reward. A reused credential drops its owner to the nadir and burns the deposit. An honest agent pays once and earns its share undiluted.
